header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None is present on behalf of the petitioners nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2023 and lastly fixed on 03.05.2023, on that no one was present. No efforts have been made by the counsel for the petitioners to get the matter fixed before the Court or to proceed with it. Today position remains same. It appears that counsel for the petitioners has lost interest to pursue with the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
